Unified Approvals API (1.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

The Unified Approvals Connector is the HTTP API for managing approvals on Workfront document versions. Use it to create approvals, build multi-stage workflows with conditional stage triggers, add and remind participants, record decisions, manage reusable approval templates, search across every approval the requesting user can see, and retrieve AI brand-review results captured by bot reviewers on a stage.

Authentication

The connector supports one authentication method:

Method Header/Cookie Use case
Bearer Authorization: Bearer <token> IMS Bearer token from Adobe IO / Developer Console

All endpoints accept Bearer token auth.

Note on auth error codes: The AIO gateway performs credential pre-flight before routing to the service.

Condition HTTP status error_code
Authorization header absent 403 403010 — "Oauth token is missing."
x-api-key header absent (valid Bearer present) 403 403000 — "Api Key is missing."
Token present but invalid or expired 401 401013

The first two cases are caught by the gateway and never reach the service. The 401 case is handled by the service itself.

Asset Types

Endpoints currently only support DOCV (Workfront document version) as the assetType path parameter.

Base URL

https://workfront.adobe.io/workfront-approvals/

Approvals

Approval lifecycle: create, read, delete

Get approval

Get approval details for an asset. Returns the full Approval object when an approval exists. When no approval has been created for the asset yet, returns a partial response containing only isApprovalActive, isEsmAsset, frameSyncStatus, and userInfo.

Create approval

Creates an approval with the supplied path data. The paths array in the body defines the approval structure, with stages nested under paths[].stages, and is used as-is. Supply one path for a single-path approval or multiple paths for parallel stage sequences. templateId is optional metadata: the caller is expected to have fetched the template separately (GET /api/v1/templates/{templateId}) and copied its paths into the request body. When templateId is supplied, it is recorded on the new approval and the corresponding template's usageCount is incremented and lastUsedOnDate is refreshed.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
required
Array of objects (ApprovalPathCreate) non-empty

Path definitions used to build the approval, each with its own stages. Supply one path for a single-path approval or multiple paths for parallel stage sequences. The server uses these paths as-is and does not look up or expand any referenced template.

templateId
string

ID of the template used to create this approval, if any. Recorded on the approval for traceability and used to increment the template's usageCount and refresh lastUsedOnDate. The server does not load paths from the template — the caller must fetch the template via GET /api/v1/templates/{templateId} and copy its paths into the paths array.

Delete approval

Deletes the approval for the given asset. The asset must be in an editable state. Check userInfo.isEditable on the approval response to determine whether the requesting user can perform write operations.

Returns suggested approval payloads derived from prior document versions, shaped for use when creating a new approval on the current asset. Results are ordered newest version first.

Bulk lookup approvals by asset ID

Simple bulk lookup of approvals for a known list of asset IDs within a specific asset type. Provide the asset type in the path and an array of assetIds in the body to retrieve their approvals in a single call. If no body is supplied, the endpoint returns approvals for projects owned by the requesting user that are currently in review. Asset IDs with no approval are included in the response array as a stub containing only assetId and frameSyncStatus: null.

required
stageId
string

Optional client-assigned identifier for this stage, unique within the approval. If omitted, the server generates one. Use human-readable values (e.g. "legal-review") when referencing this stage in another stage's parentIds for sequential approval flows.

name
string
deadlineDate
string or null <date-time>
deadlineBusinessDays
number or null
object or null

Time-of-day component of the stage deadline in UTC. An object with two numeric properties — hours (0–23) and minutes (0–59) — that, paired with the date derived from deadlineBusinessDays, pins the deadline to a specific moment. The client must calculate any offset for a specific time zone and convert the desired local time to UTC before sending this value. Returned values are also in UTC; the client must not apply an additional offset based on the viewing user's time zone. The deadline remains the moment intended by the user who set it, regardless of the viewer's time zone. Set to null when no time-of-day is configured.

Example: { "hours": 0, "minutes": 0 } for 5:00 PM MST (00:00 UTC).

object
Default: {}

Almost entirely a Frame.io integration artifact — when a Frame.io share is created for the stage it holds the generated review link and comments link. Defaults to {} if no Frame share was created (for example, on non-ESM or non-Frame assets).

required
Array of objects non-empty
object (ApprovalStageConfig)
parentIds
Array of strings

IDs of stages that must complete before this stage activates.

Array of objects (StageTrigger)
customMessage
string <= 500 characters

Optional message for participants when this stage activates

pathId
string

ID of the path this stage belongs to, when the stage is part of a multi-path approval.

Responses

Production

https://workfront.adobe.io/workfront-approvals/api/v1/approvals/{assetType}/{assetId}/stages/{stageId}

Decisions

Make and delete decisions on approval stages

Make decisions

Makes a decision on one or more stages. If the decision already exists it will be updated. Overall stage and approval status is recalculated after each decision. Throws an error if the approval is not found or the current user is not a participant.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
Array
stageId
string

ID of an existing stage on the approval to attach this participant to (e.g. design-review).

participantId
string
participantType
string
Enum: "USER" "TEAMOB"
participantRole
string
Enum: "approver" "reviewer"

Role this participant plays on the stage.

  • approver — Has a binding vote; their decision directly affects stage and approval status.
  • reviewer — Non-binding; can mark reviewed but does not block approval progression.

The role, combined with the participant's current decision, also drives the userInfo.action value on every approval response — see Approval.userInfo.action for the role/decision → action mapping.

ParticipantUserMetadata (object) or ParticipantTeamMetadata (object) (ParticipantMetadata)

Free-form metadata about the participant. The shape varies by participantType:

USER participants

{
  "isBot": boolean,
  "participantIdType": "wf_guid" | "ims" | "email",
  "wfUserId": "string",
  "emailAddr": "string"  // omitted when not available
}

TEAMOB (team) participants

{
  "isBot": boolean
}

See ParticipantUserMetadata and ParticipantTeamMetadata for the typed shapes. Additional context-specific properties may be present; consumers should treat unknown keys as informational.

Create grouped approval

Creates a grouped approval: a set of document versions that move together through one or more approval paths, each an ordered sequence of stages with its own participants. Optionally associate it with a Workfront parent object via parentId/objCode, or seed it from a templateId.

Authorizations:
Bearer
header Parameters
x-api-key

Search grouped approvals

Searches grouped approvals using a named view. The default awaitingApprovals view returns groups where the requesting user (or one of the supplied teamIds) is a participant on the active stage and a decision is still required. Results are cursor-paginated: send limit for the first page, then the returned cursor for each subsequent page.

Authorizations:
Bearer
header Parameters
x-api-key
required
string

client_id of the Adobe Developer Console technical account. Identifies the calling integration to the AIO gateway.

x-gw-subdomain
required
string

Workfront customer subdomain (e.g. mycompany). Must match the subdomain of the Workfront instance being accessed. Passing an incorrect or unrecognized subdomain will result in a 502 Bad Gateway response from the AIO gateway.

wf-customerid
required
string

Workfront customer ID.

wf-userid
required
string

Workfront user ID of the acting user.

wf-lane
required
string
Enum: "prod" "preview" "hub" "staging" "devtest"

Workfront deployment lane.

x-request-id
string <uuid>

Unique identifier for request tracing. Auto-generated if not provided.

x-correlation-id
string

Unique identifier for correlation across multiple service calls. Auto-generated if not provided.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
view
string
Default: "awaitingApprovals"
Value: "awaitingApprovals"

Named view that determines the response shape. Currently only awaitingApprovals is supported.

teamIds
Array of strings

Optional team IDs; the search also matches groups where one of these teams is a participant.

cursor
string or null

Opaque cursor for the next page (from the prior response). When a non-null cursor is sent, limit is ignored.

limit
integer <= 100
Default: 20

Page size for the first page, when no cursor is supplied. Defaults to 20, max 100.

Responses

Production

https://workfront.adobe.io/workfront-approvals/api/v1/grouped-approvals/search

Request samples

Content type

  • "view": "awaitingApprovals",
  • "teamIds": [
    • "string"
    ],
  • "cursor": "string",
  • "limit": 20
}

Bot Reviews

AI brand review results from the Bot Registry

Search AI brand reviews

Returns AI brand-review results produced for a document version under an approval. Each review is generated when a bot reviewer participant runs against a stage on the approval and captures the bot’s pass/fail findings against the brand’s guidelines. Filter results by bot, document version, parent document, or stage to narrow the response to a specific asset, review run, or stage on its approval.

Authorizations:
Bearer
header Parameters
x-api-key
required
string

client_id of the Adobe Developer Console technical account. Identifies the calling integration to the AIO gateway.

x-gw-subdomain
required
string

Workfront customer subdomain (e.g. mycompany). Must match the subdomain of the Workfront instance being accessed. Passing an incorrect or unrecognized subdomain will result in a 502 Bad Gateway response from the AIO gateway.

wf-customerid
required
string

Workfront customer ID.

wf-userid
required
string

Workfront user ID of the acting user.

wf-lane
required
string
Enum: "prod" "preview" "hub" "staging" "devtest"

Workfront deployment lane.

x-request-id
string <uuid>

Unique identifier for request tracing. Auto-generated if not provided.

x-correlation-id
string

Unique identifier for correlation across multiple service calls. Auto-generated if not provided.

Request Body schema: application/json
botEauthUserId
string

The Workfront eauthUserID of the bot. Maps to associatedTechnicalAccountId on the bot record. Required if objId and parentObjId are not provided.

parentObjType
string
Value: "DOCU"

Type of the parent object.

parentObjId
string

ID of the parent object (the document). Required if objId and botEauthUserId are not provided.

objType
string
Value: "DOCV"

Type of the object being reviewed.

objId
string

ID of the object being reviewed (the document version). Required if parentObjId and botEauthUserId are not provided.

stageId
string

ID of the stage on the approval.

page
integer
Default: 1
limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 20

Responses

Production

https://workfront.adobe.io/workfront-approvals/api/v1/bot-reviews/search
